jobs.description:
Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:

• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations.  
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed.  
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly.  
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities.

• 
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.

• 
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 

• 
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.

• 
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.

• 
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.

• 
You communicate well in English.

• 
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.

• 
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

Our client is a leading international industrial group recognised for its innovation-driven strategy and global footprint. To support its continued growth through strategic acquisitions and investments, the company is expanding its specialist M&A legal team in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities include:

• Leading domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments
• Managing all legal aspects of complex cross-border transactions
• Structuring transactions and providing commercially focused legal advice
• Drafting and negotiating sophisticated transaction documentation
• Coordinating multidisciplinary deal teams across Legal, Strategy, Finance, Tax, Treasury, HR, Compliance and IT
• Managing external counsel across multiple jurisdictions
• Leading signing, closing and post-completion activities
• Supporting integrations, reorganisations and carve-out transactions
• Advising senior executives on strategic legal risks and transaction execution
• Contributing to the continuous development of our client's M&A legal capability

• Belgian Master of Law (or equivalent European qualification)
• Significant experience in Corporate/M&A law (typically 8  years)
• Background within a top-tier international law firm and/or sophisticated in-house M&A environment
• Outstanding drafting and negotiation skills
• Proven experience leading complex cross-border transactions
• Strong commercial judgement and strategic thinking
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Ability to operate autonomously in an international environment
• Fluent English; French and/or Dutch are advantageous

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Jobomschrijving

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

jobs.occupation: Senior Portfolio Manager - Brussels - Private Banking
jobs.description:
Our client is a specialised player within private banking and wealth management, supporting a defined professional client base with tailored investment solutions. Their offices in Brussels are easily accessible and offer a collaborative environment focused on expertise and long-term value creation.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and monitor investment portfolios for high-net-worth clients
• Develop and implement investment strategies aligned with client objectives and risk profiles
• Work closely with relationship managers to support client advisory activities
• Conduct financial and market analyses to identify investment opportunities
• Participate in investment committees and contribute to strategic decisions
• Oversee portfolio performance, risk exposure and asset allocation
• Support the continuous development of investment processes and expertise

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in portfolio management, investments or private banking
• Fluent in Dutch, with a professional knowledge of English and/or French
• Strong understanding of financial markets, asset allocation and investment strategies
• Analytical, autonomous and detail-oriented in decision-making
• Effective communicator with a collaborative approach towards internal stakeholders

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365
• Fluent English and Dutch

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Design Office - Dilbeek - Fast Growing Company
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian engineering group with offices located in the Dilbeek area, offering a modern and easily accessible work environment. You will join a structured technical department within a stable and growing industrial organisation.

Jobomschrijving

• Coach and develop a team of 10 technical specialists
• Organise and oversee the daily planning of the technical office
• Provide technical advice to clients, project managers and internal teams
• Prepare and validate cost calculations and technical quotations
• Analyse technical drawings, specifications and client requirements
• Manage client communication regarding ongoing orders and changes
• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

• Master's degree in civil engineering, architecture or a technical field
• Minimum 8 years of proven experience in a technical office environment
• Native Dutch speaker with good command of English and French
• Strong analytical mindset with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Initial experience in team management or coaching is required

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

Toyota offers a comprehensive remuneration package, including interesting extra-legal benefits. Toyota provides flexibility to take care of both your career and your personal life by providing hybrid work environment with structural possibility to both work from home & collaborate in the office. 

At Toyota Motor Europe, they are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all. All recruitment decisions are based on the individual and their qualifications along with the job requirements. The selection process is without regard to nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, date of birth, religion, ethnicity, disability or other personal characteristics. Toyota do not tolerate harassment or discrimination as our individual experiences and overall diversity is a key strength. Together, let's have the power to make a positive change and go beyond the ordinary. If you need any specific consideration for the interview process due to disability or any other reason, please let the recruiter know.

Jobomschrijving

Team/division description

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.

Your responsibilities

• Prepare Purchase Orders, and proceed receiving and invoicing 
• Process technical reports towards official issuance acc. to our internal process 
• Prepare and format documents, reports, presentations
• Establish guidelines and procedures 
• Actively propose and implement cost reduction and efficiency ideas 
• Support the team’s digitalization processes 
• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. 
• Support internal and external communication with stakeholders. 
• Assist in organizing events, workshops, and team activities. 

Your profile

• Proven experience as administrative assistant 
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
• Rigorous and self-disciplined
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Flemish and French are a plus.
• A very good knowledge of Excel is required (advanced formulas, pivot table...), and powerBI. A good command of powerApp is a plus.
• Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• You have a Toyota DNA, this means:
Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach

Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible

Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation

Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

Our client is an International Banking Institution with an established presence in Belgium.

To strengthen its Compliance team in Antwerp, the organization is currently looking for a Compliance Officer who will support the Head of Compliance and AMLCO across a broad range of regulatory and financial crime compliance responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the Compliance Manager in the execution and monitoring of the annual compliance plan
• Contribute to the review and implementation of AML/KYC policies, procedures and transaction monitoring processes
• Ensure timely and accurate preparation of regulatory reporting and returns
• Perform ongoing transaction monitoring and escalate relevant alerts and findings to the AMLCO
• Provide compliance advice to the business regarding customer onboarding, KYC reviews, transactions and risk classifications
• Review name screening alerts, sanctions and potential matches identified during customer onboarding and periodic reviews
• Support compliance matters related to corporate banking, credit facilities, syndicated lending and correspondent banking
• Perform compliance reviews and testing in accordance with the Compliance Monitoring Plan
• Contribute to the periodic review of transaction monitoring parameters and controls
• Support the assessment and review of client, country and business-related compliance risks
• Perform data quality controls across the different compliance tools and systems
• Contribute to the Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment and other compliance-related projects

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics or another relevant field
• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience within Compliance in the financial sector
• Good understanding of AML/KYC, Customer Due Diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions and embargoes
• Previous experience within banking or another regulated financial institution is a strong advantage
• A financial crime or compliance certification is considered an asset
• Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders
• Pragmatic, proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
• Very good command of English is required, Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in implants and orthodontic solutions who is at the forefront of digital transformation in dentistry, offering complete workflows that integrate software and hardware solutions-from patient entry into the dental practice to final prosthetic delivery.
The company emphasizes a personal approach, coaching, and growth opportunities, with decisions made locally to adapt to market needs.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Manage and grow existing accounts (approx. 65% farming) and acquire new customers (approx. 35% hunting) by building, developing and maintaining strong & long-term relationships with dental professionals and stakeholders
• Drive sales of dental implants, prosthetic, and digital solutions in East Flanders & Antwerp, focusing on hospitals, dental practices, and dental labs.
• Understand customer needs and provide complete solutions, from patient acceptance and diagnostic data capture to surgery and final prosthetic delivery.
• Educate dental professionals on the benefits, the utilization and the clinical aspects of products and digital workflows.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high-quality services and products delivery 
• Organize workshops, lunch-and-learn sessions, and participate in trade show

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following profile:

•  3 years of experience as Account Manager in the Pharma or Medtech industry
• Previous experience in both direct and indirect sales, with strong ability in farming and hunting
• Previous experiences or strong interest in dental products
• Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• You are structured and proactive, you achieved KPI & are accurate with CRM update
• Your are autonomous, disciplined, and results-oriented, with a collaborative team spirit.
• Dutch Native & Fluent in English .

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:

• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
• Good physical condition for physical work.
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
• “You are open to working weekends.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

• Our client is a leading European consumer services organization operating across multiple international markets.
• Recognized for its customer-centric approach, the company continuously invests in service excellence, operational efficiency and process improvement.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor and assess customer interactions and service quality performance to identify trends, gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Design, coordinate and manage customer experience assessment programs, including quality audits and mystery shopping initiatives across multiple countries.
• Analyze customer feedback, operational performance metrics and quality data to support informed decision-making. 
• Map and evaluate customer journeys across channels, identifying friction points and recommending practical improvement actions.
• Collaborate with operational and regional stakeholders to support the implementation of service quality and customer experience initiatives.
• Prepare insightful reports, dashboards and presentations for leadership teams, translating data into clear business recommendations.

• Bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Operational Excellence, Business Analysis or a related field.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and transform insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
• Able to work autonomously in a cross-functional environment.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Flexible to travel across Europe (approximately 20%).
